name: 72 Ways Architects Use Claude
tagline: Seventy-two concrete uses, mapped to the design stage each belongs to.

page.objective: Give architects a concrete catalogue of what to actually use AI for, filed by the stage they are working in.
page.problem: General AI advice never survives contact with an architect’s actual week.
page.solution: Seventy-two specific uses, each tied to a design phase and a delegation map.
